tei:div.tei:p: (1na)rje dwags po'i zhal gdams dang*/ rje sgom tshul gyi zhus lan bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo// ngo bo gang yin zhus pa'i/ rje'i lan gsung pa rnams brjed thor bris shing bkod pa'o// gzhan yang rang gi rig pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rig pa gnyis gang yin zhus pas/ gnyis po ma yin/ rang bzhin gyis rig pa'i ngang du lung ma bstan de yin gsung ngo*// stong pa la stong sang nge ba nyams myong can gyi stong pa dang*/ stong pa nyid yin snyam pa can gyi stong pa dang*/ spros bral gyi stong pa gsum gang lags zhus pas/ gnyis po min/ spros bral gyi stong pa yin gsung ngo*// rig pa rang dang spros bral gyi stong pa de gnyis lhan cig skyes pa de lhan skyes yin/ de ye nas gnas pa de ngo shes pa de ye shes yin gsung ngo*// mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob 'dres pa'i tshad ci tsam lags/ mnyam bzhag rtse gcig dang ma bral bar spyod lam thams cad btub pa lags sam/ rjes thob la rnam rtog dang 'grogs su yod pa lags sam/ rjes rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu (2na)lags sam/ rjes la rnam rtog tha mal du snang ba de'i rjes chod pa lags zhus pas/ snga ma ltar byung na bzang ste srid pa tsam yin/ bar pa de yis chog pa yin/ rjes la rnam rtog tha mal du song nas rjes ma chod na mnyam rjes ma 'dres pa yin gsung*/ ye shes kyi rlung la g.yo ba yod dam med zhus pas/ g.yo ba thams cad las kyi rlung yin/ de phra ba thams cad dag nas ye shes kyi rlung gcig por song tsa na sangs rgya ba yin no// ye shes kyi rlung rgyun chad dam ma chad/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod dam med zhus pas/ chos sku la rgyun chad ma chad gnyis las 'das/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes blo las 'das pa'i nyams myong dus thams cad pa chos sku yin/ gzugs sku gnyis rang snang la rgyun chad/ gzhan snang la rgyun ma chad/ 'khor ba thog mtha' 'di yin med gsung ngo*// lta ba bsgoms pa'i tshad ci tsam gyis bar dor skye ba 'dag lags zhus pas/

dbang po rab bar dor skye ba 'dag pa yin te/ dbang po rab (2ba)ngo bo gsha' ma rtogs pa la bya'o// rtogs nas bsgoms na a cang che gsung*/ rmi lam na ngo bo bsgom pa ma byung na bar dor cang 'ong ngam zhus pas/ rmi lam na ngo bo bsgom pa ma byung yang bar dor 'ong nges gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgoms pas las rlung 'dag gam mi 'dag zhus pas/ 'dag gsung ngo*// rlung bsgoms pas ngo bo e 'byongs zhus pas/ de 'byongs gsungs/ nga'i bla ma mi las gtum mo gcig po bsgoms pa yin gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgom pa dang rlung bsgom pa gnyis las rlung 'dag gang sla zhus pas/ ngo bo bsgom pa sla gsung ngo*// ngo bo chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du song ba la/ bogs 'don rgyu yod dam med zhus pas med gsung ngo*// rtogs ma rtogs kyi ngo bo dang*/ goms pa'i ngo bo la khyad yod dam med zhus pas/ yun ring thung las ngo bo la khyad med gsung ngo*// ngo bo rtogs nas ji tsam bsgoms pa de chu bo rgyun du song ba las ngo bo la bzang du song ba med gsung*/ da lta'i sgom pa'i rtogs ldan dang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas gsum gyi ngo bo la bzang ngan med gsung*/ ngo bo rtogs nas chu bo rgyun du ma song ba la shi na/ tshe snga ma phan chad la lan grangs gzhan la myong ba'i las dang*/ 'di la sdig pa byas pas phyi ma e gnod las rjes su 'brang ngam mi 'breng zhus pas/ mi gnod las rjes su mi 'breng*/ nga'i slob ma gtsang pa zhig tshe stod la/ khong gsum gyis rgyas pa zhig btsongs nas spyad pa zhig 'dir byung*/ bsgom bslabs pas skyes/ ngas khong la sdig pa sbyong dgos/ de'i thabs shes rab snying po mang po bris la 'bul dgos byas pas/ des 'dag gam zer ba la 'dag byas pas 'o na bya'o zer/ phyis ma ngas skyo sangs la song ba'i drung du byung*/ nga la sdig pa sbyong rgyu rang mi (3na)'dug zer/ khos ngo bo rtogs pa de tsug yin gsung*/

sngar gyi sdig pa rnams stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa dang*/ ngo bo yud tsam cig bsgom pa gnyis sdig pa 'dag stobs gang che zhus pas/ ngo bo yud tsam bsgoms pa stobs che gsung*/ ngo bo rtogs nas bsgom pa'i gang zag de ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin gyi ngos nas bltas na sgom lam non nas 'dug /snang ba'i rtags ngos nas bltas na/ tshogs lam chen po yang mnon par 'dug na'ang*/ ngo bo can des sa lam dang bstun na sgom lam non/ rang bzhin ni dbang che gsung*/ snang ba'i lam rtags thams cad drang don gyi bshad pa yin/ su la'ang byung ba med/ gzhan snang la snang ba tsam yin/ des na/ lam rtags rtsa rlung bsgom na/ lam dang thad dkar mthun pa'i rtags 'ong*/ de thams cad thun mong gi siddhi yin/ sangs rgya ba la mi phan/ byams chos la sogs pa nas rtags 'ong ba mang po bshad/ rtags tshad kyang rtogs pa med pa yang bshad/ rtogs pa yod kyang rtags med pa yang bshad/ rtogs pa dang lam rtags gnyis ka yod pa yang bshad/ la la ci tsug 'ong ma nges par bshad yod gsung*/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs de 'bras bu ye shes kyi rgyu yin nam/ skye ba'i rgyu yin nam/ gnas pa dang 'phel ba'i rgyu yin/ sangs rgyas man chad du zung 'brel du dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ 'bras bu ye shes bya ba de ngo bo yin/ res gnas pa dang mi gnas pa med/ 'phel 'grib med/ ngo bo ma shes pa shes par byed pa'i rgyu/ ngo bo shes nas bsod nams bsag cing*/ bsgom na gsal bar 'dug zer/ nga la bsod nams bsags kyang gsal du ma tshor ba 'dra bar 'dug gsung*/ ngo bo (3ba)bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ sdig pa'i chos 'khor ba myang 'das thams cad rang sar dag /spang bya thams cad zad 'dug na/ zad sar zad/ phyin sar phyin/ de las yar bshags kyang gung mi mthong bar 'dug na zhus pas/ de kho na ltar yin ngo bo bsgom pa gcig pus chog pa yin gsung ngo*// 'jig rten blos btang nas ri khrod 'grims pa la lto dgos pas/

ka ca bag tsam gnyer ra bya'am/ bcud len nam/ nor sgrub re bya'am mi bya/ shi ma shi med par bsgom mam zhus pas/ de yang bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ ka ca med par spangs na mi 'ong*/ rang 'tsho tsam re gnyer ra bya gsung ste/ thams cad gzhag nas bsgom pa gal che/ 'tsho ba ḍā ki mas sbyor/ bcud len ma byed grub pa yang med/ nad la phan na cong zhi bag re mi lto/ dka' thub ngas kyang ma byas/ nor sgrub sla ba re la 'gal ba yang med gsung*/ gnas grub thob kyi gnas su bsgom pa'am/ ri stong brag stong du bsgom mam/ dgon par bsgom mam/ lung zhig zhu zhus byas pas/ gnas gar bder bsgom/ rang dga' na yun ring*/ mi dga' na yun thung bya gsung ngo*// lus ngag gi dge sbyor byed snying ma 'dod na bzhag la/ ngo bo gcig pu bsgom mam zhus pas/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas mi dgos snyam na dgos rdo ba yin/ dgos mi dgos gnyis ka dang bral na mi dgos pa yin gsung ngo*// gzhan don rgyun bcad kyis/ bsgom na zhus pas/ bsam pas sems can ma spangs pas/ gzhan don la gzugs sku gnyis 'grub/ sbyor bas spangs pas chog gsung ngo*// ngo bo'i nang du skyabs su 'gro na chos nyid kyi thob pa/ sdom pa na zag med/ snying rje na dmigs med/ (4na)sems bskyed na don dam/ dam tshig na ye bsrungs/ yar ldan du tshang bas gzhan tsho mi dgos sam zhus pas/ gzhan tsho thams cad brdzun pa yin/ bden pa gcig pu bsgom gsung ngo*// kun gzhi rnam shes dang ngo bo gnyis khyad ci tsam zhus pas/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi rang bzhin ngo bo yin/ ma rig pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyis/ lag pa log pa dang 'dra/ ma rtogs bar du 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin rtogs na ye shes rtsa ba yin gsung ngo*// ngo bo rtse gcig tu yer re ba dang*/ rig pa gya gyu can gnyis gang yin zhus pas/ de gnyis ka yin/ sems kyi ngo bo 'di yin bya ba med/ snang ba thams cad sems/

sems thams cad rig pa/ rig pa thams cad ngo bo yin gsung ngo*// ngo bo la spyod lam ci tsug bsgom/ mig phye ba dang btsum pa gang lags zhus pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang dgyes bsgoms pas chog /mig 'dra ma btsum na bde ba tsug yong*/ 'byongs nas btsum pa bde/ lar btsum pa 'dre sla/ 'od gsal dang gtum mo bsgom pa la/ dang po rtsa'i sprug pa re bya/ 'dug stangs byed dgos gsung ngo*// dang po 'khrul lugs ji ltar 'khrul/ snang lugs ji ltar snang*/ rtogs lugs ji ltar rtogs/ grol lugs ji ltar grol zhus pas/ ma 'khrul pa'i gong du 'di yin bya ba mi srid/ ye 'khrul chen po// snang ba sgyu ma bag chags sna tshogs su snang*/ rtogs pa rang la yod pa'i chos sku ngo shes par rtogs/ grol yang rang grol/ rtogs pa rang rgyu'i dus na 'bras bu gnas pas sangs rgyas pa de rang yin gsung ngo*// gzhung bltas kyang shes nas 'ong*/ bla ma la dri mi (4ba)dgos gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgom tsa na kha nang du log la snying rje bsgom mam/ phyir bltas nas bsgom pa gnyis 'dra'am/ kun rdzob tu sems gang gnas pa'i sar bsgom mam/ sems gang lags zhus pas/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa dang*/ phyir bltas pa dang*/ nye ba dang ring ba dang 'dra/ ngo bos thams cad yang khyab/ phyogs thams cad pa/ dus thams cad pa yin gsung ngo*// sems rgyud nas rlung sems ngo bo gcig tu gnas pa'i don nang du grol/ phyir sor bcu gnyis tshun chad du gnas pa yin/ thag ring po'i dran pa ste sems song ba yin/ nang du dran pa song bar snang ba yin/ sems nyid 'di na yod 'di na med bya ba med gsung ngo*// ngo bo gcig pu bsgom pa la gol sa bcad yod dam/ rgya la bar dor skye ba ma dag na phyi ma gar skye zhus pas/ ngo bo bsgom pa la gol sa med/ khyod rang gi nyams la 'dug gam/ ltos dang gol sa gcig kyang med/ ngo bo bsgoms pas bar do ma mthong bar sangs rgyas thob/

rgya la ma thob na gnas gtsang ma'i 'phags par skyes nas/ sangs rgyas dang bla mas rgyud bskul nas sangs rgya ba yin/ de las 'gro sa med gsung ngo*// bdag 'dzin blos btang zin/ tshe gzhug ri khrod 'grim zhing ngo bo bsgom pa yin/ de la 'di dgos bya ba'i gdams ngag cig zhu/ rgya la gnyan sar 'gro ba'am ri stong lung stong du 'dre rgod dang phrad pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi bar chad byung na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ ri khrod 'grim pa la lta ba'i gdeng dang*/ sgom pa'i gdeng dang*/ snying po lha'i gdeng dang gsum ldan par bya/ de las gzhan med gsung ngo*// gnyan sar 'dre rgod bar chad rtsom pa la/ gnas de na gnas pa la gtor ma byin la bar (5na)chad dang gnod pa ma byed bya/ chos skyong la gtor ma btang*/ ḍā ki chos skyong dang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ snying po mang du bzlas na bar chad mi yong*/ sangs rgyas nas 'o skol bar la brgyud pa bzhi las med/ de rnams kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sus bsgom pa'i phyi bzhin khyi bzhin du 'breng par 'dug pas slob ma sgom pa yong ba la bar chad 'byung ba med gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgom pa'i steng du lha rnams kyang mi 'gong ba yin/ 'dre la sogs pas mi tshugs pa yin/ stong pa lha 'dres kyang bsgom shes sprul pa sna tshogs shes kyang*/ ngo bo rtogs ma myong*/ ngo bo bsgom mi shes/ ngo bo lha 'dre'i yul du ma gyur pas/ ngo bo bsgom pa dga' gsung ngo*// gtum mo la 'jam rlung dang rtsub pa rlung gi khyad ci lags zhus pas/ rlung drag tu gnon pa dang*/ zhan par gnon pa las med/ dmigs pa'i yul 'dra/ yi ge dang me 'od 'dra gang byas kyang btub/ gnyis ka la 'og rlung mi sdom pa bla ma mi la'i lugs yin/ rlung nan ltar 'byongs na 'og rlung bag re sdom/ 'od gsal gtum mo la rtsis che ba yin gsung*/ ngo bo bsgoms pas thun mong gi siddhi 'ong ngam zhus pas/

'ong bar bshad nas 'dug /phal cher gtum mo bsgoms pa las 'ong ba yin/ ngo bo bas kyang gnas pa can la thun mong 'ong ba yin/ sangs rgyas mi 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi zas za ba de ji ltar byas pas 'ong zhus pas/ bla ma mi la la dgongs mo tsa na ḍā ki mas ston mo drangs/ zas za ma dgos skyug chil li 'ong zhing 'dug gsung*/ gnas pa shas che ba'i rtse gcig las ma yengs pa la lto mi dgos pa 'ong bar 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu mi 'ong ngo (5ba)bo med gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgom pa la nyams myong mchis ma mchis zhus pas/ nyams su myong na nga rgyal dang*/ chags pa yin/ 'jig rten la zhen pa lings kyis bor ba zhig 'ong ba yin/ chos gzhan yo la dgos med du phyi shun du lings te 'gro /rang la yid ches pa'i blo bde lhan gyis 'gro ba yin/ ngo bo la nyams rtogs rnams 'ong gsung ngo*// bar dor skye ba dag tsa na lus dang rig pa bral dus/ ngo bo rang du chos skur 'gro'am/ 'on te rig pa 'og min du 'gro ba lags zhus pas/ rig pa phar song nas srid rtse man chad las 'das pa'i 'og min bya ba med/ 'di rang du blo las 'das pa'i chos sku la 'og min zer ba yin/ rig pa la 'gro 'dug med/ ngo bo la 'gro 'dug med/ ngo bo la mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med pa'o gsung ngo*// rnam rtog byung ba sems yin nam sems las byung ba yin/ sems yin na rnam rtog sna tshogs su song ba yang ngo bor song la/ sems las byung ba yin na rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi thog nas bsgom na/ gzhi thog tu 'gro bas rtse gcig tu bsgom 'tshal na/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus su mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thob med pa yin pas/ rnam rtog gi thog tu song ba yang ngo bo yin pa lta bur yod/ de nyams su len pa'i dus su rnam rtog tu mi bsgom/ gzhi thog tu 'gro bas rtse gcig 'ba' zhig tu bsgom gsung*/ ngo bo rtogs pa'i dus su ma rig pa dag pas rlung dag kyang*/

de rlung gis rtogs pas g.yo ba de ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa'i rtog pa yin pas/ dge mi dge'i 'bras bu gang yang mi 'byin pa lags sam zhus pas/ de tsug yin rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i rlung rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i rtogs pa yin pas/ 'bras bu de rnam smin gang yang 'byin mi nus gsung ngo*// (6na)sgyu lus 'od gsal dang gtum mo bsgoms pas rlung dhū tir tshud dam mi tshud/ rgyud kyi drod rnyed dam mi rnyed/ 'og rlung 'then pa yang btub bam mi btub zhus pas/ 'od gsal gtum mo bsgoms pas drod me la dmigs pa dang khyad med pa 'ong*/ dhū tir dmigs pa dang khyad med par tshud/ 'jam rlung dang rtsub rlung dang 'og rlung 'then pa kun 'od gsal dang gtum mo la byed pa yin gsung ngo*// rlung phyed len de ma thub na en tsam zhig btang nas/ 'phro bcad nas gnon nam/ 'on te tshur btang nas rngubs gnon lags sam zhus pas/ de phyi ma ltar gnod pa yin gsung ngo*// lta ba cha mthun khyad 'phags shig zhu zhus pas/ sems tsam dang thams cad sems su 'dus pas mthun/ sems tsam ni sems don dam du 'dod la/ ngo bo ni sems skye ba med pas 'phags/ dbu ma dang spros bral du mthun te/ ye shes kyis khyad par 'phags/ sngags kyi theg pa tsho ni rnam bden du mi 'dod/ rnam par grol ba'i lam dang mthun te/ ma rgyud pa bde ba yul du byas nas bsgom/ rdzogs chen stong pa yul du byas nas bsgom/ phyag rgya chen po ba btang snyoms yul du byas nas bsgom/ de tsho blos byas yin/ blos ma byas pa'i ngo bo gnas lugs bsgoms pas ngo bo 'phags/ cha mthun khyed rang gis bltas pas 'ong*/ lar nyams su len pa de gang dang mthun par go na byin rlabs che gsung ngo*// sems kyi ngo bo dang*/ don gyi ngo bo gnyis khyad gang lags zhus pas/ sems kyi ngo bo ni gsal la ma 'gags pa yin/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'gyu ba de yin/

don gyi ngo bo ni sems kyi ngo bo'i rang bzhin gzhi shes pa de yin/ don gyi mtshan nyid ni skye ba med pa yin gsung ngo*// mkhyen pa gnyis (6ba)dang ye shes lnga po de sangs rgyas kyi dus na ci tsug mnga' zhus pas/ de tsho bshad pa thams cad blos byas kyi yon tan yin/ 'o skol gyis kyang blos byas nas 'bru mnan na/ chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis la sbyar du btub ste/ don la sangs rgyas bya ba blo las 'das pa yin/ chos sku lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin/ gzugs sku gnyis la gzhan kho rang gi blos byas pa de gtso bor snang gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgoms pa las rlung dag pa'i rtags lnga dang*/ phan yon brgyad la sogs pa 'ong ngam mi 'ong zhus pas/ 'ong ba yin te ngo bo gnas pa rgyun du gnas na rgyun du 'ong*/ res 'jog la res 'jog tsam las mi 'ong gsung ngo*// ngo bo bsgoms pas rlung a wa dhū tir tshud nas 'dag gam/ ma tshud par 'dag gam zhus pas/ der tshud nas 'dag pa yin/ tshud kyang rang bzhin gyis tshud nas 'gro ba yin gsung ngo*// rig pa thams cad la stong pas khyab/ stong pa thams cad la rig pas khyab bam zhus pas/ rig pa thams cad la stong pas khyab/ stong pa thams cad la snang bas khyab pa yin gsung ngo*// tsog tsog por 'dug nas phyag rgya ma byas par rlung bsgom na e mchi zhus pas/ des 'ong dang 'ong ste dus rtag tu tsog pur rkang pa gnyis bshibs nas bsdad na/ rgyud nas rgyu ma rul bar bshad/ skyil krung yon tan mang po bshad pas dga' gsung ngo*// da lta mnyam bzhag 'od gsal du 'dug kyang*/ rjes la rig pa rlung gis g.yo ba ltar snang nas/ rlung ma dag na bar dor yang de tsug mi 'ong ngam zhus pas/ mi 'ongs te bla ma mar pa'i bzhed pas 'chi tsa na 'byung ba rim gyis thim nas/ rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pa'i dus su/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i skad cig ma sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags/ snang ba mched pa la thim pa'i dus su/

(7na)'dod chags las gyur pa skad cig ma bzhi bcu 'gags/ mched pa thob pa la thim pa'i dus su/ gti mug las gyur pa'i skad cig ma bdun 'gag /thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas tshe 'di la 'od gsal ngo shes pas/ der ngo 'phrod nas mi ldang bar rtag tu gnas so// 'dir ngo ma shes pa la ni/ la cha grang mo 'byar du ma btub pa'o// bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// gsung ngo*// bka' gdams pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang*/ sngags bsgom par 'dug ste/ khong gi zhal nas rab 'di/ 'bring bar do// tha ma phyi ma la sangs rgya/ de la ma rgyas na/ sngags kyi lam la phyi bar mi sdod pas/ bsdad na dam tshig nyams pas mnar med du phogs cig 'gro /rten 'brel dbang che gsung ngo*// 'di la rlung dag kyang rjes la ldang ba lus byung ba lnga yod pas gsung*/ bar dor lus med pas mi ldang*/ khyod bla ma la dri mi dgos/ nang du rig pa'i sgro 'dogs chod nas 'ong gsung ngo*// las kyi rlung lung ma bstan dang*/ rnam rtog sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ yul lnga la sogs pa'i snang grags thams cad sems las logs na mi 'dug pas mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thams cad sems nyid gcig pa lags sam zhus pas/ de kho na yin te/ thams cad sems yin/ thams cad sems nyid dus thams cad pa yin/ rnam rtog 'phro ba de rang rig dang stong pa gnyis su med pas/ rnam rtog tu 'phro ba sems kyi dri ma'am/ bag chags yin/ rang 'gro rang snang rang dag yin/ dus thams cad du sems kyi ngang las ma yengs par bya ba las med/ lan cig goms pa'i dus su dran pas ma yengs par bya mi dgos/ de nam 'ong na las kyi rlung lung ma bstan du dag (7ba)nas/ ye shes kyi rlung rang du song tsa na/ rnam rtog la bag chags kyi dri mi 'ong*/ sems 'phro ba mi 'ong*/ dran pa brten mi dgos/ ma yengs pa bya mi dgos gsung ngo*// gnyid kyi dus mi rtog pa yod de/

rig pa bag la nyal du gnas pa de/ mnyam gzhag yin nam min/ rmi lam dus su rig pa yod de mi rtog par 'dug na/ rig pa la mi rtog pa rang chas su yod pas/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'gro'am mi 'gro /mi 'gro na gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam gyi dus su sgyu lus bsgom dgos sam zhus pas/ gnyid kyi dus su rig pa bag la nyal min/ rig pa gsal sing nge yod pas mi rtog pas ma tshor ba yin/ 'od gsal dang sgyu lus bsgom mi dgos/ gnyid dang rmi lam dus su 'od gsal rang chas su yod pas chog /dran pas ma zin pa de nyid sad pa'i rjes su bltas pas/ de yang 'od gsal las gzhan med par yid ches pas chu bo rgyun yin gsung ngo*// bar do'i gdams pa 'tshal lam mi 'tshal zhus pas/ bar dos ci byed/ da lta dang 'chi kha gnyis kha ru bar do bsgom mi dgos/ 'od gsal gcig po bsgom/ 'od gsal dus thams cad pa yin pas bar do mi mthong*/ dper na dgra mi 'ong ba la zon dang skyel ma mi dgos gsung ngo*// yul gcig la dmigs pa gang las 'phos pa de la yer re bsgom pa dang*/ de las tshur log nas bsgom pa gnyis gang dga' zhus pas/ de gnyis 'dra/ sems dang sems kyi 'od gnyis bzhin du go ba ma yengs par bsgoms pas sems dang sems kyi 'od dus thams cad ma yengs pa gces gsung ngo*// da bla ma la dri mi dgos khyod rang gi rig pa'i the tshom thams cad chod nas 'ong*/ dri mi dgos gdos thag chod la sgoms shig /nga dang gtan nas mi 'bral bar (8na)dus thams cad du yod pa yin gsung ngo*// da bdag la don phul du byung ba dang*/ gdams pa ma tshang ba yod na zhu zhus pas/ da don la phul du dbyung rgyu yang med/ gdams pa ma tshang ba yang med/ sangs rgyas la rgyu med pas/ khyod rang nyams myong la ltos/ nga 'das ma 'das med par khyod sems kyis bzung gis/ byin gyis rlob pa a cang che/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang ḍā ki ma thams cad kyang*/

khyod sgom sgrub byed pa'i phyi bzhin 'breng*/ byin gyis rlob par 'dug /khyod la bar chad mi 'ong don grub nas 'ong*/ khyod rang sems nyid rin po che gdos thag chod pa sgoms shig gsung ngo*// bla ma rin po che la ngo bo'i gdar sha gcod pa zhus lan dang bcas pa/ nyams rtogs thams cad kyi 'phrang sel bar byed pa rdzogs so// //las can 'ga'i snyan du thos nas mos pa skye zhing rtogs pa 'char/ skal med log lta can la gdams ngag 'di ni gsang bar bya'o// snod bcud phra rag rtag pa gcig kyang med// dran pa'i rgyal po ma yengs lta bsgom// sna tshogs rkyen gyis mi 'gyur de la brtson// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun las gzhan mi btsal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i snying po yin gyur nas// bdag don grub nas gzhan don 'bad med 'byung*// e ma ya mtshan che bas rang sems ltos// sems mthong rnam grol dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzod// rje sgam po pa dang*/ rje sgom tshul gyis zhus lan 'di/ lang ban dharma ku mā ras/ ri khrod dgon par bris pa'o// //dwags po sgom tshul gyi bu chen dam pa bag sgom gyi zhal nas/ spyir sgrub pa byed pa la bya ba lto gos la gyong bkur nas/ sdug nus pa zhig byed dgos pa yin pas/ blo phugs sprang la gtod/ (8ba)rang 'dod pa las blo ldog dgos pa yin pas/ tshe 'di skyong ba rnams dang snang blo ma bstun na/ bya rgyu sems can gyi don las med pas phan ci thogs gyis/ yag tu re ba'i skyid skyid po zhig la blo gtad pas mi yong ba yin no gsung*/ snang sems zhen med kyi lha sku la// sgyu ma'i yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// sku gsum ngo sprad kyi rje btsun la// dad gus kyi yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// rang bzhin skye med 'od gsal la// gcer mthong gi yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// spyod pa rang 'byung 'gag med la// chos nyid kyi nyams dang mi 'bral 'tshal// slob dpon dwags po sgom tshul gyis gsungs so//

//rtogs ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po rtogs 'dod rnal 'byor gyis// gang gis mi bskyod rgya mtsho lta bur gzhag /gsal la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' lta bur gzhag /nyams la thogs rdugs med pa bar snang rlung bzhin gzhag /'khor 'das gnyis med yin pas chos nyid ngang du gzhag /dus gsum rang bzhin chos kyi sku yin te// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa mkhyen par mdzod// rnam rtog ma bslad chos nyid rang bzhin te// ma bcos rang sar grol ba mkhyen par mdzod// e ma ho// chos rnams thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang*// rang bzhin mi dmigs bsgom du med pa'i ngang*// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin rtsa bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// rnam dag rang bzhin skye med chos sku'i ngang*// ma bsam lhun gyis grub pa chos kyi sku// dus gsum mnyam par snang ba gnyug ma'i lam// rang bzhin spros dang bral ba rnal 'byor sems// sku gsum rang la shar ba skye med thugs// 'khor 'das thams cad gnyug ma'i klong du thim// gzung 'dzin thams cad skye med (9na)dbyings su yal// rtsol sgrub thams cad ma bcos lam du slongs// 'bras bu thams cad thob tu med pa shar// phyag rgya chen po brjod du med pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun rin po che tshul khrims snying po'i zhal nas gsungs pa'o// //rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed 'dir tshogs pa'i sgom chen pa rnams/ sgrub pa rnal mar byed na tshe 'di'i gdos thag bcad nas/ lus srog 'ben du btsugs/ lto rgyab la gyong bskur nas/ sgrub pa nyams su len dgos pa yin/ de ltar byed pa la ri khrod bsten dgos pa yin/ rab seng ge bzhin du gangs la song*/ 'bring rgya stag bzhin du nags la song*/ tha ma bya rgod bzhin du brag la song*/ dur khrod kyi wa mo bzhin du grong du gzhol bar ma byed/ lar zas gos gnyis kyi 'khri bas tsho ba la rib mi 'ong bas/ gos ras gos rkyang pa thub pa gal che/

zas gyi na tsam la brten nas che rung chung rung don cig sgrub na/ tshe 'di la skyid kyang bzang*/ sdug kyang bzang*/ ci byung 'dra snyam pa zhig dgos/ lar chos byed na mi thams cad la re ma che/ mgu ma sla/ 'khang ma skyen/ drin ma rtsi dang*/ yag par yong*/ kho bo ni su la drin rtsi ma myong ste/ kho bo ni khyed cag rnams la drin che snyam/ lar slob mas slob dpon gyi zhabs 'dren pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i zhabs 'dren pa gnyis mnyam po yin la/ kho bo'i slob mar gyur pa thams cad/ rab skye ba 'di la bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod pa yin/ khyed tsho rang mgo rang gis ma brdung*/ rang la rang gis thugs la thogs dang*/ nges par de kho na ltar yin/ spyir chos byed pa la kha chos par ma song ba/ sla chos par ma song ba/ lo chos par ma song bar gyis/ mis kyang chos byed snyam/ rang (9ba)gis kyang chos byed snyam nas/ mi nag tu 'chi nyen yod pa yin pas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras bsgom pa gal che/ 'di brtson 'grus kyi lcag yin/ lar chos sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag de/ rab 'chi khar dga' yal le/ 'dzum mu le/ brod ting nge*/ bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba zhig dgos/ 'bring 'chi khar mi 'tsher ba zhig dgos/ tha ma lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas/ ngas 'di dang 'di byas snyam pa'i 'gyod pa med pa zhig dgos/ sgom chen pa rnams ri khrod bsten dgos pa de/ bya bral g.yeng ba thams cad pas dben par rtse gcig tu nyams su len par 'dod nas/ ri khrod bsten pa yin/ g.yeng ba byed na grong gseb dang sde pa'i nang du byas pas chog pas/ ri la bsdad kyang grong gseb pa las g.yeng ba che ba ma byed dge sbyor la brtson par gyis/ dge sbyor cig skyes na de yin te/ dge sbyor ni mi bzad pa'i gter chen po yin/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin skye ba thams cad kyi bsod nams yin pas shin tu gal che/

dge sbyor de skyes kyang goms pa mthar phyin dgos/ sgom lta thog tu skyel dgos pa yin/ de lta bu zhig gis gzhan don byed pa yin pas/ de min pas gzhan don byas pas rang la gnod/ gzhan la phan par dka' bas/ sngon la rang don mthar phyin par mdzod la/ de nas slob ma skyongs/ rang don mthar phyin pa la ri khrod 'grim pa gal che/ de la bka' gdams pa'i zhal nas/ ri khrod 'grim pa la chos lnga yin gsung*/ tshul khrims la ngos lkog med/ gnyen pos rkyen thub pa/ gdams ngag la rang byan tshud pa/ dad pas khams sos pa/ nus pas gnod pa phra mo sel nus pa zhig dgos gsung*/ bde (10na)bar gshegs pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ ri khrod bsten pa la chos bzhi yin gsung*/ gdams ngag gi gdeng thob pa/ nus pa'i gdeng thob pa/ nyams myong gi gdeng thob pa/ lta ba'i gdeng thob pa zhig dgos te/ don de tsho dang ldan par byed pa la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes nye bar 'jog pa/ gsol ba rgyun chad med pa 'debs shing*/ bla ma'i spyan sngar yun ring dgos/ bya mos lung pa thob pa bzhin song bas mi chog /de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la go 'dris su ma song ba/ gdams ngag la sna dred du ma song ba/ dad pa snod rnying du ma song ba gal che/ mi lus rin po che thob/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ chos rin po che thos/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che dang mjal/ gdams ngag rin po che zhus/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rang dbang yod pa'i rten 'brel 'di rnams 'dzom steng la bsgom dgos/ de'i dus su bsgom na bsgom mi yong mi srid/ ma byung na rang gis ma bsgoms pa yin/ bla ma mnyes par byed pa la/ rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog yin/ 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog yin/ tha ma zang zing gi zhabs tog yin pas/ chos gsha' mar byas na rang don gzhan don kun 'byung*/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dus thams cad du skyid/ skyid pa rang skyid/

smon pa mis smon pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ de ltar ma byas na/ 'phya ba mis 'phya/ sdug pa rang sdug /'bras bu ngan song gsum du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ khyed rnams snying thag pa nas chos bya snyam na/ brtson 'grus dang*/ gnyen po dang*/ dad gus kyi stobs bskyed la/ bla ma dang grogs po'i zhabs 'dren du ma song ba/ sems can gyi sdig rkyen du ma song ba/ mdor na las mtha' ma log pa re mdzad par zhu gsung ngo*/// /
